user_request: Build a customer self-service portal for insurance policy renewals.
executive_summary: Replace emailed renewal packs with an authenticated customer portal for eligible policies.

functional_requirements: The system shall allow a customer to renew an eligible policy online.
The system shall send a renewal confirmation to the customer.
The system shall display current premium and coverage before confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Given an eligible policy, when the customer confirms renewal, then a confirmation record is stored.
